explain: A small capstone names supported tasks and explicit exclusions so completion is testable. Feature count is not the same as useful coverage.
steps: Define one coherent user journey. || Keep unsupported capabilities outside the initial acceptance contract.
name: capstone-scope

explain: A staged product grows from a deterministic vertical slice into evaluated AI and recoverable deployment. Prerequisites prevent adding realtime polish before correctness exists.
steps: Define milestone dependencies. || Select only milestones whose prerequisites are complete.
name: learning-sequence

explain: An engineering log distinguishes AI assistance, human decisions, and executed verification. Authored code is not automatically tested code.
steps: Record assistance and personal review separately. || Preserve the command or result that supports the verification claim.
name: honest-ai-log

explain: Choose the next learning experiment from the largest measured weakness, not from framework popularity. The decision uses task-impact evidence and a bounded hypothesis.
steps: Rank observed failures by affected task count. || Select one boundary to investigate in the next controlled experiment.
name: next-experiment

explain: A roadmap and its examples document learning evidence, while operating and collaborating supply additional experience. This checklist is a self-review artifact, not certification or a hiring rule.
steps: Keep reading completion separate from demonstrated implementation and recovery. || Report unproven capabilities honestly during a review or interview.
name: learning-evidence-boundary

explain: A reproducible handoff needs setup, synthetic fixtures, architecture, limitations, and verification instructions. The manifest identifies missing documentation before someone else runs the project.
steps: Declare the necessary documentation sections. || Compare provided sections with the handoff contract.
name: project-documentation

explain: A useful report includes denominator, quality, latency, and full task cost, including failed runs. The numbers remain tied to a described synthetic workload.
steps: Record the sample size and failures with completion counts. || Calculate completion rate without excluding failed tasks from the denominator.
name: portfolio-report
capstone-production-evidence-verifier
explain: A production capstone verifier asserts multi-tenant cache isolation, streaming protocol terminal framing, and receiver-side idempotency, separating authentic engineering from shallow tutorial demos.
steps: Verify tenant-scoped semantic caching to prevent cross-tenant data leaks. || Ensure streaming connections emit terminal frames on normal completion and mid-stream errors. || Enforce receiver-side idempotency to guarantee duplicate event dispatches commit exactly once.
expect:
=== Testing Capstone Production Evidence & Invariant Verifier ===
Cross-Tenant Cache Isolation Check:
  Tenant A Cache Hit: True
  Tenant B Cache Hit on Same Query: False (Zero Data Leakage)

Streaming Error Boundary Check:
  Mid-stream failure emitted terminal frame: error (is_terminal=True)

Receiver-Side Idempotency Check:
  Attempt 1 Status: COMMITTED
  Attempt 2 Status: REPLAYED (Zero Duplicate Mutations)

All production capstone architectural invariants verified successfully.
